title.en: Execute a Morpho Vault V2 market cap increase (after the timelock ends)
title.zh-TW: 執行 Morpho Vault V2 市場上限的提高（timelock 到期後）

summary.en: The Safe calls the vault's `multicall` to execute two calls queued earlier with `submit` whose timelock has ended: raise the absolute cap of the market you pick to the amount you type, and its relative cap to the percentage you type. It moves none of the Safe's assets.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 vault 的 `multicall`，執行之前 `submit` 排好、timelock 已到期的兩個呼叫：把你選的市場的絕對上限提高到你填的數量，相對上限提高到你填的百分比。不動 Safe 的任何資產。

intro.en: Morpho Vault V2 spreads deposits across several Morpho Blue markets. The curator sets how much each market can hold (its cap), and the allocator moves funds within the caps. Raising a cap takes a `submit` first, and it can run only after the timelock has passed.
intro.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 把存款分配到多個 Morpho Blue 市場。curator 設定每個市場能放多少（上限），allocator 在上限內搬錢。提高上限要先 `submit`，等 timelock 過了才能執行。

text.en: Vault V2's GitHub lists 10 audits (Spearbit, Zellic, Blackthorn, ChainSecurity, Certora and one contest).
text.zh-TW: Vault V2 的 GitHub 列了 10 份稽核（Spearbit、Zellic、Blackthorn、ChainSecurity、Certora 和一場競賽）。

text.en: Anyone can execute: once the timelock ends, any address can send these two calls; the contract checks only `executableAt`. The caps you type must be exactly the ones in the original `submit`, or the vault reverts.
text.zh-TW: 執行不限誰：timelock 到期後任何地址都能送出這兩個呼叫，合約只檢查 `executableAt`。你填的上限必須跟當初 `submit` 的一模一樣，不然 vault 會 revert。

recommendation.en: Type the numbers from the original submit. verify confirms that after the transaction both caps equal what you typed.
recommendation.zh-TW: 照當初 submit 的數字填；verify 確認交易後兩個上限都等於你填的。

text.en: AI has no browser that runs JavaScript, so it did not open the market's page on the Morpho app. AI read Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` on chain (market id 0x64d65c9a2d91c36d56fbc42d69e979335320169b3df63bf92789e2c8883fcc64), and the oracle it answers is 0xA6D6950c9F177F1De7f7757FB33539e3Ec60182a. The market id is the hash of the five parameters, so a different oracle means a different market.
text.zh-TW: AI 沒有能跑 JavaScript 的瀏覽器，沒打開 Morpho app 的市場頁。AI 在鏈上讀 Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams`（市場 id 0x64d65c9a2d91c36d56fbc42d69e979335320169b3df63bf92789e2c8883fcc64），回答的 oracle 就是 0xA6D6950c9F177F1De7f7757FB33539e3Ec60182a；市場 id 是五個參數的 hash，換掉 oracle 就是另一個市場。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. To check again, open this market's page on the Morpho app and compare the oracle address.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；想再確認就在 Morpho app 打開這個市場頁比對 oracle 地址。

text.en: AI read Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` on chain: for both markets, usdc-usp-915 and usdc-usp-86, the oracle it answers is 0x5096642B7c7CD82198932f3FADd873EC2fcDeb6d. The market id is the hash of the five parameters, so a different oracle means a different market.
text.zh-TW: AI 在鏈上讀 Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams`：usdc-usp-915 和 usdc-usp-86 兩個市場回答的 oracle 都是 0x5096642B7c7CD82198932f3FADd873EC2fcDeb6d；市場 id 是五個參數的 hash，換掉 oracle 就是另一個市場。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. To check again, open these two markets' pages on the Morpho app and compare the oracle address.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；想再確認就在 Morpho app 打開這兩個市場頁比對 oracle 地址。

text.en: The page is on etherfi.gitbook.io, not ether.fi, the site DefiLlama lists. CoinGecko's ether-fi coin links its whitepaper on etherfi.gitbook.io, and the page lists weETH as 0xCd5fE23C85820F7B72D0926FC9b05b43E359b7ee, the address CoinGecko lists for Wrapped eETH.
text.zh-TW: 頁面在 etherfi.gitbook.io，不是 DefiLlama 列的 ether.fi。CoinGecko 的 ether-fi 幣把白皮書連到 etherfi.gitbook.io，頁面上的 weETH 是 0xCd5fE23C85820F7B72D0926FC9b05b43E359b7ee，跟 CoinGecko 列的 Wrapped eETH 地址一樣。

recommendation.en: Acceptable: CoinGecko lists the same address.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受：CoinGecko 列的是同一個地址。

role.en: The vault's asset, also the token the markets lend
role.zh-TW: vault 的資產，也是市場借出的代幣

role.en: Morpho Blue itself; the markets live inside it
role.zh-TW: Morpho Blue 本體，市場在它裡面

role.en: The oracle the market uses to price cbBTC
role.zh-TW: 市場用來給 cbBTC 定價的 oracle

role.en: The factory that creates Vault V2 market adapters. It answers `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true: it created the adapter
role.zh-TW: 建立 Vault V2 市場轉接合約的工廠，它回答 `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true，轉接合約是它建立的

role.en: The collateral token of the USP markets
The oracle the USP markets use to price USP
role.zh-TW: USP 市場用來給 USP 定價的 oracle

role.en: The collateral token of the weETH market
The oracle the weETH market uses to price weETH
role.zh-TW: weETH 市場用來給 weETH 定價的 oracle

1.multicall.data.en: The two calls the vault runs in order, fixed at two items: the absolute cap first, then the relative cap. If either fails, the whole transaction fails.
1.multicall.data.zh-TW: vault 依序執行的兩個呼叫，固定兩項：先絕對上限，再相對上限。任一個失敗，整筆失敗。

1.multicall.data[0].en: Item 1: execute the queued absolute cap increase.
1.multicall.data[0].zh-TW: 第一項：執行已排隊的絕對上限提高。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The data that identifies the cap. The vault uses its keccak256 as the cap's id; here it means "this market in this adapter".
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 上限的編號資料。vault 用它的 keccak256 當上限的 id，這裡是「這個轉接合約裡的這個市場」。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The kind of id, fixed to this/marketParams: a cap on one market, not on the whole adapter or on a collateral token.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this/marketParams：單一市場的上限，不是整個轉接合約或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into Morpho Blue markets.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The market's five parameters, which together are the market you pick.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 市場的五個參數，合起來就是你選的市場。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The token the market lends, equal to the vault's asset.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 市場借出的代幣，等於 vault 的資產。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The new absolute cap: the most assets the vault can put into this market. It must equal the number queued earlier.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 新的絕對上限：vault 最多放多少資產進這個市場，必須等於當初排隊的數字。

1.multicall.data[1].en: Item 2: execute the queued relative cap increase.
1.multicall.data[1].zh-TW: 第二項：執行已排隊的相對上限提高。

1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..en: The data that identifies the cap. The vault uses its keccak256 as the cap's id; here it means "this market in this adapter".
1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..zh-TW: 上限的編號資料。vault 用它的 keccak256 當上限的 id，這裡是「這個轉接合約裡的這個市場」。

1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..en: The kind of id, fixed to this/marketParams: a cap on one market, not on the whole adapter or on a collateral token.
1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this/marketParams：單一市場的上限，不是整個轉接合約或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into Morpho Blue markets.
1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場。

1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..en: The market's five parameters, which together are the market you pick.
1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..zh-TW: 市場的五個參數，合起來就是你選的市場。

1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..en: The token the market lends, equal to the vault's asset.
1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..zh-TW: 市場借出的代幣，等於 vault 的資產。

1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..en: The new relative cap: the largest share of the vault's total assets this market can hold. It must equal the number queued earlier.
1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..zh-TW: 新的相對上限：這個市場最多占 vault 總資產的比例，必須等於當初排隊的數字。
